title: Where did it live?

doesNotKnow: The bone starts upstream in this stipulated scenario and is buried downstream. Its burial site is the direct location of the deposit; the animal’s habitat needs additional evidence. The arrows show a model, not a real find.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: A toy model shows a bone carried by a stream before burial downstream. Which location does the burial site identify directly?

If a modeled shell is carried downstream before burial, does the burial point alone fix where its animal lived? No. Transport can separate the burial location from the living habitat.
